**Needs changes before merge.** The code is sound and all tests are green. Two items block.

Tier: this is not a SAFETY-tier review. The diff changes `crates/ui` AI Chat code, one guide page and one decision file. It does not change posted G-code, a gouge or collision check, stock simulation or geometry. No recorded program (`*.nc`, `*.cl`, `examples/catalog/**`) changed. No heavy lane applies.

## What looks good

- The panel stores keys through the existing `keychain::store` / `forget` / `secret::lookup` functions. It adds no second store.
- The draft clears on save, cancel, window close and provider change. Mutation 1 below proves the pin.
- Remote error text and keychain error text do not go to the UI.
- Credential and network work runs on a worker thread. One job is in flight at a time. A stale result is replaced before it is drawn.
- Layering is correct (ui -> app). Each new file has a provenance line and is below 400 lines. No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` is outside the tests.
- The body has before and after screenshots. The four PNG files exist on the fork's `pr-screenshots` commit `5c3d533bf`. The source branch has no image.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/3781-ai-key-setup.md` is present. The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3781`.

## Results, merged with main (local build, macOS)

Trial merge of `df6457c95` with upstream/main `db3bb1f7f`: clean.

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | pass, 10/10 steps, 0 failed |
| `camcraft-ui` lib | 1547 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored |
| ui suites `boundary`, `boundary_picks`, `contour_dxf_sketch`, `sinker_setup`, `tap_hand`, `theme_example`, `theme_files`, `waterjet_tool` | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass |

Extra suites run (the diff changes `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md`, which these read):

| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test ai_guide` | 3 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_doc_drift` | 6 passed |
| `site/tests/test_ai_guide.py` | 3 passed |
| `site/tests/test_guide_refresh.py` | 14 passed |
| all `site/tests` | 103 run. 6 subtests of `test_search_query.py` gave an error: this host has no `node`. The PR does not touch that code. |

The diff touches no `testdata/` file and no importer code. Those extra selections do not apply.

Mutations that I ran again:

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove `self.draft.clear()` in `Settings::close_editor` | red: `cloud_key_editor_clears_secret_on_cancel_and_provider_change` and `cloud_key_save_replace_remove_and_test_never_draw_saved_secret` failed |
| Bypass the offline guard for cloud Test in `Settings::start` | red: `cloud_provider_test_refuses_offline_mode_before_backend_dispatch` failed |
| Restored code | green: 10 of 10 `ai_chat::settings` tests passed |

## Requested before merge

1. **The PR closes #3781, but it does not supply all that the issue asks for. The body does not say so.** Supply each item, or change `Fixes #3781` to `Refs #3781`, file a follow-up issue for each open item, and name it in the body.
   - The live provider smoke tests are missing. The reporter's comment on #3781 asks for `#[ignore]` tests in the lane `live-ai`, "run before the reporter's hand-test". The tree has no `live-ai` test. The body asks for the hand-test now.
   - That comment also asks that a wrong key gives a "key rejected" status. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_native.rs:96` gives one message for a wrong key, a wrong model, no credit and no network.
   - The Ollama text of the issue is not in the guide or in the panel: `ollama serve`, the check command, `OLLAMA_HOST`, `OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH`, `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE`.
   - The Gemini text of the issue says that a Gemini app subscription does not include an API key. The guide does not say this.
2. **Each edit of the Model field starts a new credential read.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings.rs:62` compares the full request, and the request includes the model text. The cloud check does not use the model. Thus each character typed in **Model** for a cloud provider reads the OS keychain again. On macOS, a user who chose **Allow** (not **Always Allow**) gets one password prompt for each character. For Ollama, each character sends one `/api/show` request. Fix: for a cloud provider, do not start a new check when only the model changes. For Ollama, start the check when the edit ends or after a short delay. Add a test that counts the backend calls during a Model edit.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_native.rs:40`: each Ollama error that is not a 404 gives "Ollama not running". An empty or invalid model name (`wire::check_model`) also gives this text, which is not correct.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings.rs:116`: on wasm, `thread::Builder::spawn` fails. The status is then "could not start. Click Test to retry", and the text "Provider setup needs the desktop app." cannot appear.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_panel.rs:80`: I did not test if the undo history of the egui `TextEdit` keeps the draft after `draft.clear()`. If it does, an undo in the opened editor puts the old text back into the masked field. A test for this is a good addition.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings_panel.rs:68`: the new window has no `layout_window_<window>` test in `page_layout_windows.rs`. This PR is not a refit, so I do not request it here.
- `settings_panel.rs:124` and `:129`, guide lines 43 and 54: the example name "CamCraft on my Mac" also shows on Windows and Linux.
- `settings_panel.rs:107`: I could not open `https://platform.claude.com/settings/spend-limits` from this host. Check each link in step 1 of the hand-test.
- Not exercised here: the real OS keychain, a live cloud request, a live Ollama server, Windows, Linux, wasm.
- #3781 says that the PR stays a draft until the reporter's hand-test is on the PR. This review does not flag it ready.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The PR now uses Refs #3781. Follow-up #3803 tracks the live-ai tests. Follow-up #3804 tracks the key rejected status. The reporter hand-test waits for the live lane. Ollama startup, check commands, and options now appear in the panel and guide. Both explain the Gemini subscription limit. Pins: `provider_help_explains_ollama_options_and_gemini_subscription` and `test_provider_setup_explains_ollama_options_and_gemini_subscription`. Removing the help made each pin fail; restored tests passed.
2. Cloud Model edits preserve readiness without another keychain read. Ollama waits for a 500 ms pause. Pins: `cloud_model_edits_do_not_read_credentials_again_and_test_uses_latest_model` and `ollama_model_edits_check_once_after_the_last_keystroke_pause`. Four additional pins cover queued and in-flight actions. All six source mutations failed their pins. Restored settings tests passed 17/17.

Head: `e207e2355d74232d227b7d797c49f626720c909f`.

Clippy passed. The example catalog passed 39 tests, with four ignored. Rust guide suites passed 3+6 tests. Python guide suites passed 4+14 tests. No goldens moved.

The final quick gate passed 9/10 steps. Seven existing UI tests failed because this host has no GPU adapter. All eight integration suites passed. Screenshot capture also failed with `No adapter found`. The PR body records these limits and preserves the existing immutable images. No evidence files entered the source branch.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.

## Requested before merge

1. **NEW blocker: the browser build panics when the AI Chat tab is open.** Class: a direct `std::time::Instant` read in code that the wasm32 build runs.
   - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/settings.rs:4` imports `std::time::Instant`. `settings.rs:71` calls `Instant::now()` in `Settings::sync`.
   - `settings_panel::draw` calls `sync` on each frame (`settings_panel.rs:12`). `panel.rs:98` calls `settings_panel::draw` on all targets. The `settings` module has wasm32 arms (`settings.rs:180`), thus it is part of the browser build.
   - On wasm32-unknown-unknown, `std::time::Instant::now()` panics. `crates/app/src/clock.rs:1` gives the rule: code that times itself reads `camcraft_app::clock::Instant`, never `std::time::Instant`.
   - The Prime Directive permits no panic on a path that a user can start.
   - Fix: import `camcraft_app::clock::Instant` in `settings.rs`. Keep `std::time::Duration`. On a native build the alias is the same type, thus the tests do not change.
   - Rule for the whole class: `grep -n "std::time::Instant\|time::{.*Instant" crates/ui/src/egui_app/ai_chat/*.rs` must show test files only. Today `settings.rs` is the only hit outside the tests.
   - The earlier review could not see this. The fix commit `e207e2355` added these lines.

- `settings.rs:84`: after a Test that passed, a cloud Model edit keeps the status "Ready (key from ...) - Test passed". The new model was not tested. The in-flight case has the correct text ("Model changed. Click Test to test this model."), but the completed case does not. If you agree, correct it in the same push. If not, it is a follow-up (`P7`).

- The screenshots show the first implementation. The new help text is in collapsed sections, and the structural test `provider_help_explains_ollama_options_and_gemini_subscription` checks it. I do not request new images for this round.

**Reporter hand-test, 2026-11-23 (macOS, combined build of #3798 + #3799 on main `da1cae00`): NOT OK yet.** What worked: the "Get or manage an API key", "Billing / credits" and "Usage / spending controls" links open the right console pages. Set API key saves to the keychain, the status reads "Ready (key from keychain)", and the help text reads well.

Findings:
1. **Anthropic (Cloud) cannot be made to work with the Model field empty.** The Model field shows the LOCAL hint "Automatic: installed tool-capable model" for a cloud provider. Test then fails ("Test failed. Check the key, model, billing credits, and network"). The reporter replaced and re-tested the key several times with the same result. An empty cloud Model must resolve to the provider's table default (`claude-sonnet-5-5` for Anthropic) and show it, or show that default as the hint. The local "Automatic" hint belongs to local providers only (it may come from the #3799 merge in `panel.rs`).
2. **Test stays enabled with "No key - Set API key...".** Disable it, with a hover reason, when no key is found.
3. **"Test failed" is too generic.** Not forwarding remote error text is right, but map the HTTP status to a safe reason: 401/403 key rejected (#3804), 404 model not found, 400 bad request/model, 402/credit errors billing, 429 rate limit, 5xx provider unavailable, plus network errors. Show the model that was tried.
4. **Help: the console's key dialog.** When you create a key, the Anthropic console now first asks "Connect to the Claude API - Where does your code run?" (Your own machine / Cloud or Kubernetes / CI pipeline / Somewhere else). Tell users to choose **"Somewhere else - Use an API key"**; the other choices do not give a key.

More from the reporter's hand-test (2026-11-23):
5. **With an explicit model it works.** Model `claude-sonnet-5-5` gives "Ready (key from keychain) - Test passed". This confirms that finding 1 (empty cloud Model) is the blocker.
6. **A leading space in the Model field makes Test fail.** Trim whitespace from the Model field, and from the key on Save.
7. **(Raises finding 3.) A failed Test gives no information at all.** The reporter: "there is zero debug/info on why it didn't work, nor what to try". Needed:
   - a **Details** line or disclosure with the safe parts of the failure: HTTP status, the provider's error type/code (e.g. `not_found_error`, `authentication_error`, `invalid_request_error`), the model and endpoint tried, never the key;
   - **one "what to try" hint per cause**: re-check the model name (and list valid ones, #3783), set or replace the key, check billing and spend limits, check the network or proxy;
   - the same details written to the app log, so a bug report can include them.
